observation: The raw facade fixture deliberately retains six visible Direct supports at the same positions as its independent sewn body; both authored geometries render.
contract: Raw surface snapshots carry no Direct source IDs. The facade must preserve unrelated or intentionally visible Direct objects and cannot infer that they should be consumed.
retake: Keep the initial raw file/unchanged Direct assertion. Use the actual DirectPanel Hide action, Undo and Redo before Save/fresh Open to inspect the independent body clearly.
previewRepair: Selected-source Sew has explicit captured IDs, so only its live candidate display can omit the identified sources without modifying saved visibility.
